src.title: Low Calorie, High Protein Cinnabon Cinnamon Roll

recipes.title: Low Calorie Cinnabon-Style Cinnamon Rolls

items.i: brown sugar substitute, e.g. Swerve (24 g)
powdered sugar substitute, e.g. Swerve (48 g)

steps: Mix the flour, yeast and salt, then add the warm water and mix thoroughly. Cover and let rise 1–3 hours at room temperature (or overnight in the fridge).
Heat the oven to 350°F. Divide into 4 balls and roll each on parchment into a 6 × 2 in strip.
Mix the syrup, brown sweetener and cinnamon, spread over the strips and roll them up.
Place in a greased or lined 8 × 8 or 9 × 9 dish and bake 21–23 minutes. Rest 15 minutes.
Stir the glaze ingredients together and spread over the rolls. Chill an hour or more for a thicker glaze.
recipes.notes: Macros per roll as stated in the description. No yeast? Swap the water for 128 g nonfat Greek yogurt (makes 3 rolls).
